note: Districts of the waterbody-impact module. Roles: 'reference' = districts whose untreated waterbodies form the published reference distributions; 'test' = districts whose results are reviewed for decisions on pooling, estimators and thresholds; 'coverage' = fetched for control pools or on demand. impact-build-registry adds the tehsils of new records with the role it is given (default coverage).

roles.reference: Untreated waterbodies here form the reference distributions published with the atlas.
roles.test: Results reviewed for decisions (pilot: Pune and Amaravati, 2023-24 desilting).
roles.coverage: Fetched for control pools or on demand.
